title: Bacon Breakfast Cups
description: Toast circles pressed into a muffin tin, topped with crispy bacon and a baked egg. The ultimate student breakfast with a gourmet twist.
steps: Cook the bacon until crispy (4 minutes each side in a hot frying pan). Set aside on kitchen paper.
Very lightly toast the bread. Using a pint glass, cut a large circle from the centre of each slice.
Grease two holes of a muffin tray and press the bread circles down into the holes.
Cut the cooled bacon into large chunks and layer in the bread cups. Crack an egg on top of each.
Bake for approximately 20 minutes until the egg whites are set.
Remove carefully and serve with the bread off-cuts for dunking.
notes: Each batch (2 cups) serves 1. Multiply as needed.
